translation.description: Read a CLUTO sparse matrix file into a simple triplet matrix.
translation.details: Read a CLUTO sparse matrix file into a simple triplet matrix.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from slam import read_stm_CLUTO
from slam._arrays import as_matrix
path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "m"
path.write_text("2 2 3\n1 1.5 2 3\n1 2\n")
print(as_matrix(read_stm_CLUTO(path)))
